li.behavioralDirective: You are bleeding slightly, feeling a little lightheaded, but you can continue acting normally.

You have serious heatstroke. You feel severe headache, weakness, confusion, and desperate relief from the heat.
You are suffering extreme heatstroke. You are fainting, severely disoriented, barely conscious, and near heat collapse.
